verdict.rationale: GitHub documents an official REST API with a fine-grained permissions model, an official CLI, and an official MCP server, giving AI-native developers concrete, first-party building blocks. However there is no explicit evidence of dedicated language SDKs (e.g., Octokit) or SDK-specific quickstart docs in the pack. Missing for 10: official language SDK documentation/examples, independent corroboration of SDK usage in AI-native workflows.
